data.gender_notes: Bulainah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic word 'bulanah' which means 'to shine', 'to radiate', or 'to be luminous'. This name is derived from the root word 'ilan' which means 'light'. In Islamic spirituality, the name Bulainah symbolizes inner illumination, wisdom, and enlightenment. The name Bulainah carries the meaning “Radiant, Shining” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Bulainah usually hope their child will grow to embody radiant, shining and live with faith, good character and purpose.
